children: that a subsidiary has entered into an agreement to acquire University Village, a premier open-air shopping and dining center in Seattle, Washington.
University Village features nearly 600,000 square feet of retail space and more than 100 businesses and services.
The center houses prominent brands and retailers, including Apple, Crate & Barrel, Lululemon, Aritzia, Vuori, RH Gallery, and Din Tai Fung.
The acquisition strengthens Simon's portfolio of high-quality retail assets in major markets.
The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.
